svg.text: Laser cut to the same outline as the outer plate, from 3 mm aluminium.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes from the main shaft centre, as on the outer plate, except:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft hole 32 mm (clearance, no bearing on this plate);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gearmotor output hole 28 mm, 289 mm up, 15 mm back;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: gearmotor screw slots 9 mm wide, 8 mm long up the plate: 40 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: either side of the output hole and 40 mm above it;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countershaft bolt slots countersunk on the case side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spacers (make 2): 16 mm bar, 86 mm long, ends square, drilled 6.8

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and tapped M8 20 deep at both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the spacers stand between the plates on M8 screws, countersunk

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the outer plate, button heads on this plate's outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the plates are parallel, 86 mm apart, at the spacers.
